caption: This is a miniature of the backrooms. The model captures an infinite, subterranean car park—a repetitive maze of concrete pillars and grey floor tiles. Each room is identical, stretching into a deep perspective that suggests a space without an end. Deep within the heart of this construction, a tiny figure remains, still searching for a way out of the concrete labyrinth.
